event.distribution_pattern: These Soom Chocolate Sweet Tahini squeeze packets were distributed throughout the United States, primarily as samples shared with consumers, distributors and sales reps. A very limited amount was sold on soomfoods.com and via Amazon.com. Those listings have since been removed from both platforms.

products.product_description: Soom Chocolate Sweet Tahini Halva Spread 30 ml ( 1oz )Squeeze Pack
products.reason_for_recall: Soom Foods is recalling its 1oz Chocolate Sweet Tahini Halva Spread squeeze packs (Code: 67333D)because our contracted manufacturer, Xela Pack, discovered Salmonella in a sample.
